title: Holy Spirit in Creation
definition: The Holy Spirit in creation refers to the Spirit's divine involvement in giving life, ordering creation, and sustaining what God has made.
summary: The Spirit of God is present and active in the work of creation and life.
christFocus: Creation is through the triune God, and the Spirit's life-giving work prepares believers to see the new creation life given through Christ.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture shows the Spirit of God present in the beginning. Creation is not independent of Him. The Spirit gives life and is involved in the ordering and sustaining of what God has made.

This doctrine guards against treating the Spirit as only a New Testament reality. The Spirit is eternally God and active in the works of God from the beginning.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People sometimes separate the Spirit from creation or think of Him only as a feeling in worship. This doctrine matters because the Spirit is the divine giver of life, not an impersonal experience.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Worship the triune God as Creator. Receive your life as God's gift and remember that the same Spirit who gives life also renews life in Christ.
